## STEP 1 – Scene
This is a Caesar salad: chopped romaine coated in a creamy dressing, with a few croutons and possibly a little grated cheese.

## STEP 2 – Vessel
The salad sits on a square white dinner plate, about 24 cm per side. Its area is roughly 24 × 24 ≈ 576 cm².

## STEP 3 – Items
- Chopped romaine lettuce
- Creamy Caesar dressing coating the leaves
- Croutons (about 4–6 visible cubes)
- A trace of grated parmesan

## STEP 4 – Area
The food covers about 35% of the plate, in a central mound.
- Romaine (with dressing mixed in): about 31%
- Croutons: about 4%, scattered on top

Together these add up to the ~35% covered.

## STEP 5 – Volume
- **Romaine:** 31% of 576 ≈ 179 cm² × 4 cm height ≈ 715 ml
- **Croutons:** 4% of 576 ≈ 23 cm² × 1.5 cm height ≈ 35 ml

## STEP 6 – Grams
- **Romaine:** 715 ml × 0.19 (dressed, somewhat compacted leaves) ≈ 136 g
- **Croutons:** 35 ml × 0.4 (dry, bread-like) ≈ 14 g
- **Dressing:** the leaves are heavily coated, so about 30 g
- **Parmesan:** about 5 g

## STEP 7 – Energy
| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Romaine | 136 | 17 | 23 |
| Croutons | 14 | 410 | 57 |
| Caesar dressing | 30 | 450 | 135 |
| Parmesan | 5 | 420 | 21 |
| **Total** | **185** | | **≈ 236** |

## STEP 8 – Sanity check
This is a moderate side or starter Caesar salad covering about a third of the plate. About 185 g and 236 kcal is plausible for that amount.
